content.short: Sentio lets you monitor, analyze, and diagnose data for decentralised applications in one place.
content.description: Sentio is a developer-friendly platform that helps you gain actionable insights, secure assets, and troubleshoot transactions for your decentralised applications from a single, unified workspace. It offers centralized monitoring, in-depth analysis, and data diagnostics across multiple chains, empowering developers to observe performance, detect anomalies, verify activity, and resolve issues quickly. Supported networks include Aptos, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Polygon, Solana, OP Mainnet, and Polkadot, making cross-chain visibility practical and efficient.
content.meta: Sentio is a dev tool for insights, asset security, and troubleshooting for dApps.
